Batteriq is Kenya's only authorised EcoFlow dealer and distributor. As the official channel, we guarantee genuine products, official warranty coverage, and local after-sales support. About EcoFlow in Kenya

Batteriq is an authorised EcoFlow dealer in Kenya. We stock the EcoFlow range by series, from KES 3,799 to KES 461,799, with extra batteries, solar panels and accessories to build a complete backup system.

Read moreShow less

The RIVER series (3 models, from KES 32,999) is compact and light, for Wi-Fi, laptops, lights and travel — start with the EcoFlow RIVER 3. The DELTA series (7 models, from KES 54,065) is home backup for a TV, fridge, Wi-Fi and lights — start with the EcoFlow DELTA 3 1000 Air. The DELTA Pro series (2 models, from KES 291,399) is high-capacity, expandable whole-home backup — start with the EcoFlow DELTA Pro.

We also carry 8 EcoFlow extra batteries from KES 27,949, such as the EcoFlow EB300 Extra Battery (RIVER 3), which add capacity to compatible DELTA and RIVER stations. For solar charging there are 8 EcoFlow panels from KES 7,599. Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty. 4 of our EcoFlow stations list app control, so you can check charge levels and power use from your phone.

EcoFlow stations charge from the wall or from solar panels, and many accept extra batteries for more capacity. Compare them on our comparison page. Pay by M-Pesa, card or cash on delivery, with same-day delivery in Nairobi and delivery to all 47 counties with an eTIMS invoice.

Frequently Asked Questions — EcoFlow Kenya

Is Batteriq an authorised EcoFlow dealer in Kenya?+

Yes. Batteriq is Kenya's official authorised EcoFlow distributor. All products are 100% genuine with official EcoFlow warranty coverage and local after-sales support.

How do I buy EcoFlow in Kenya?+

Browse our EcoFlow range, add to cart, and checkout. We accept M-Pesa STK Push (instant, pay now), cash on delivery, and M-Pesa on delivery. Our team confirms your order within minutes.

Can I pay for EcoFlow with M-Pesa?+

Yes! Batteriq offers instant M-Pesa STK Push checkout. Enter your Safaricom number at checkout, and you'll receive a payment prompt on your phone. Confirm with your M-Pesa PIN and your order is paid instantly.

Does EcoFlow deliver in Nairobi?+

Yes. Batteriq offers same-day and next-day delivery within Nairobi, and nationwide shipping across all 47 counties in Kenya.

What is the EcoFlow warranty in Kenya?+

All EcoFlow products come with the official manufacturer warranty — 24 months for power stations and accessories. Batteriq is the authorised warranty service partner in Kenya.

Which EcoFlow series should I choose?+

Choose by what you need to run. RIVER: compact and light, for Wi-Fi, laptops, lights and travel; DELTA: home backup for a TV, fridge, Wi-Fi and lights; DELTA Pro: high-capacity, expandable whole-home backup. Send us your appliance list on WhatsApp and we will recommend a model.

Can I add more batteries to an EcoFlow power station later?+

Many DELTA and DELTA Pro models accept EcoFlow extra batteries; each product page lists whether it is expandable and by how much. Tell us your model on WhatsApp and we will confirm which extra battery fits.
